timeline.summary: Chief Financial Officer Shri Prasad Barre resigned effective April 30, 2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹627.65 Cr (-40.0% YoY), net profit ₹436.1 Cr (against a loss of ₹4.38 Cr a year earlier).
ITI Limited published its Annual Report for FY2025-26, highlighting a disclaimer of opinion from statutory auditors and a steep decline in revenue.
